body: Here it is clearly 3D shape of mouth and other parts are not detailed enough to have meaningful difference in acoustics. And also parts are in wrong positions. Lips are round, not realistic and so on. You need to be able go generate 3D photos of our generation and compare with actual anatomy to make sure they align perfectly. At all slices/orientations and so on. We need to find high quality data sources for the topic to be actually temporary used to compare at least (clean room development), in tests if possible to download just in time, or if in public domain we can just use files and host them directly in this repository. If the app tab is not active for sometime in browser (I switched to another tab it stops working at all, no more sound after coming back). All these limitations must be lifted: ``` The waveguide tiers are 1D and accurate up to about 5 kHz. Only the 3D tiers model transverse modes. The piriform fossae exist in the waveguide only. At the 1 cm high grid the incisors are one voxel thick. The palate and velum meshes are schematic, not segmented from MRI. ``` We still can have a setting to get back to 1D waveguide, but we should support full 3D sound generation based on actual shape closer to reality. We need to double check our sources, and add ability to make as accurate 3D model as possible, we should use tools like blender if needed and so on, or just make sure we create accurate 3D model using code. I need real 3D simulated acoustics with default configuration at much higher quality, we still should be able to configure back to current level of detail. Voice for female and child still does sound more similar to male voice. I need a breakthrough at SOTA of 3D acoustic simulation. Better than all competitors, there should be a way to beat even neural networks generation in quality. Also double check all my previous undelivered requirements. Current version should be available at ./v2 url, and do so for every next version, so all versions are fully available in UI to compare if needed. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: We need to improve quality
